title: InfinityStar: Uniﬁed Spacetime AutoRegressive Modeling for Visual Generatio

predicted_errors.error_location: Abstract and Introduction (Section 1) vs. Experiments (Section 4.5, Table 6)
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The abstract states: 'Without extra optimizations, our model generates a 5s, 720p video approximately 10× faster than leading diffusion-based methods.' The introduction claims 'a 10× reduction in inference latency relative to leading diffusion models.' However, Table 6 reports a 32× speedup over the diffusion model Wan-2.1 (1864 s vs. 58 s) under comparable conditions. The experimentally reported speedup (32×) contradicts the 10× claim, making the abstract/introduction statements factually inconsistent with the paper's own results.

The text states: 'For inter-clip predictions, clips are generated sequentially conditioned on prior clip predictions and the text input in an autoregressive manner.' However, Equation (2) is given as p(r_1^1, ..., r_K^N) = ∏_{c=1}^N ∏_{k=1}^K p(r_k^c | r_1^c, ..., r_{k-1}^c, ψ(t)), which conditions each scale only on same-clip earlier scales and text, ignoring all previous clips. This factorization does not include the dependence on prior clips' token blocks (r_{<c}), contradicting the described inter-clip autoregression and making the likelihood formulation inconsistent with the method.

References [7] (Chen et al., Panda-70M) and [15] (Ju et al., MiraData) appear in the bibliography but are never cited anywhere in the paper's text. This constitutes an unused/misplaced reference, which a careful reviewer would flag as a citation error.
